intended_interpretation: Measures behavioral divergence between instructed experimental conditions (e.g., prompt compliance). Reflects task-directed compliance differences, NOT verified lie detection.
limitations: Labels represent instructed experimental tasks (label_verified=False), NOT verified deception
Non-deceptive emotional stress, cognitive load, or camera anxiety can trigger behavioral anomalies
Lighting, head movement, and camera angle introduce signal variance
Prohibited for punitive, screening, ranking, or consequential decision-making
